{{hatnote|For the character card, see [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]].}}
'''Admiral Thrawn''' is a Star Wars CCG writing handle on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The articles index credited that handle for strategy pages on [[Flagship Operations]], [[Undercover]], [[Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater|Mobquet A-1 Deluxe]], [[Elom]]s, [[Myo]], and [[Revolution]].<ref name="or-0">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Flagship.htm Flagship Operations...Is It Powerful...Or Not????], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142346/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Flagship.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
